The FloPlast balloon leaf guard is an essential component for effective roof drainage systems, engineered to prevent leaves and debris from blocking downpipes. This robust black polypropylene gutter guard fits securely into downpipe outlets, offering reliable protection against blockages that can lead to damage and costly repairs. It is suitable for both 65mm square and 68mm half-round downpipes, making it a versatile solution for property maintenance professionals and DIY enthusiasts maintaining roofline drainage.
